description: This file defines a helper class for managing notes using an SQLite database in an Android application. It includes creation, upgrade, and CRUD operations for notes, as well as query functionalities with search capability.

classes.name: NotesDatabaseHelper
classes.description: A helper class extending SQLiteOpenHelper to manage database creation, upgrade, and CRUD operations for notes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Creates the notes table in the database.

methods.name: onUpgrade
methods.description: Handles database schema upgrades by dropping and recreating the notes table.

methods.name: insertNote
methods.description: Inserts a new note into the database with the given title and content.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by id with new title and content.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes the note with the specified id from the database.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its id.

methods.name: getAllNotes
methods.description: Retrieves all notes, optionally filtered by a search query in title or content, sorted by timestamp.

methods.name: getNoteFromCursor
methods.description: Constructs a Note object from the current position of a Cursor.
